node.title: Re^3: What is the proper way to suppress a warning in a test file?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
How do you check for the "specific warning that definitely should not happen?"

I have a simple little function that I include in my test libraries, [https://github.com/haukex/Tie-Subset/blob/369487962e8ae7f5cb2e6dca9430fe499d0978ee/t/Tie_Subset_Testlib.pm#L45|for example]:

sub warns (&) { my $sub = shift; my @warns; { local $SIG{__WARN__} = sub { push @warns, shift }; $sub->() } return wantarray ? @warns : scalar @warns; }

Then I'll [https://github.com/haukex/Tie-Subset/blob/369487962e8ae7f5cb2e6dca9430fe499d0978ee/t/20_array.t#L69|use it] like this:

sub some_module_code { my $arg = shift; warn "Some custom warning about $arg"; } my @w = warns { some_module_code("foo"); }; is grep({/\bSome custom warning\b/i} @w), 1; is grep({/\bUse of uninitialized value\b/i} @w), 0;
